result.summary: The page appears visually intact with no critical or major issues. There are minor layout observations related to cut-off content at the edges of the screen.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card is cut off on the right edge, suggesting horizontal scrolling is intended but may not be obvious to all users.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a visual cue (like a fade or arrow) to indicate more content is available by scrolling horizontally.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom is partially cut off by the navigation bar, which could obscure important information.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient padding at the bottom of the scrollable content area so that the last item is fully visible above the navigation bar.
